If the current external version identifier of an app on the App Store doesn’t match the external version identifier reported by the device, there may be an app update available for the device. > **Note**:  A newer version of an app might not be available for installation on the device for a variety of reasons. A common reason is that the device’s operating system version or hardware is incompatible with the available version of the app.
